steps: Let the power of each lens be P, so the combination has power 2P and focal length F = 1/(2P).
Given a real, 4x enlarged image, magnification m = -4.
Using the magnification formula m = F / (F + u), we substitute u = -12.5 cm to get -4 = F / (F - 12.5).
Solving for F gives 5F = 50 cm, so F = 10 cm = 0.1 m.
The combined optical power is 1/F = 1/0.1 m = 10 D.
The optical power of each identical lens is therefore 10 D / 2 = 5 D.
